summary: Final integrated review approved. The combined DB/API/UI implementation satisfies the original request: static QR/URL tagging is controlled by a per-session switch, switch-off sessions remain SUN-only, switch-on sessions support mixed SUN/static use, admin devices do not record participant tags, and final static/browser/API regression evidence is sufficient.
warnings: Web NFC reading of a real NTAG213 device was not exercised in headless validation; the shared static URL parser and browser flows were validated, and the limitation is documented.
The feature depends on applying `supabase/migrations/20260928100000_static_tag_switch.sql` before deployment; hosted final evidence records that the user applied it before hosted API checks.
evidence: `supabase/migrations/20260928100000_static_tag_switch.sql` adds `sessions.allow_static_url boolean not null default false` and defines `record_static_tag` with switch checks, team locking, token-only lookup scoped to the participant session, SUN-equivalent race rules, and service_role-only execute grants.

`src/app/api/tag/route.ts` routes token-only bodies to `store.recordStaticTag`, preserves the old 400 `태그 정보가 없습니다.` behavior for malformed/static-disabled requests, rejects UID-only bodies, and leaves the SUN path selected whenever `e`/`c` are present.

`src/lib/db.ts`, `src/lib/types.ts`, and `src/lib/race.ts` carry only `allowStaticUrl` into participant race views while tag tokens, UIDs, and key material remain stripped from participant-facing responses.
`src/app/admin/sessions/[id]/ui.tsx` implements the admin switch, warning text, conditional static URL display, copy control, and QR rendering while keeping SUN registration controls intact.

`src/app/t/[token]/page.tsx`, `participant-landing.tsx`, and `admin-static-view.tsx` implement the required routing: static participant submission only for switch-on token sessions, today's no-SUN-info screen for switch-off/unknown participant visits, and read-only admin views with no participant submission component mounted.
`src/app/race/page.tsx` and `src/lib/nfc.ts` accept pending `{token}` payloads and static `/t/{token}` NFC URLs only through the approved parser and server-authoritative `/api/tag` path.

Final static validation exists at `.ai/tasks/active/TASK-20260928-001/runtime/static/FINAL/summary.txt` with `VALIDATE_STATUS=PASSED`, `LINT_BASELINE=MATCH`, `TSC_EXIT=0`, and `lint-delta.txt` reports no new lint findings.

Final browser report `.ai/tasks/active/TASK-20260928-001/runtime/web/FINAL/report.md` records `BROWSER_STATUS=PASSED` and covers admin switch/URL/copy/QR, direct and pending static participant flows, switch-off behavior, admin read-only behavior, SUN flows, and token hiding.

Final hosted API evidence `runtime/web/FINAL/hosted-api/api-check-static.hosted.out.txt` reports `ALL PASS` across switch behavior, mixed SUN/static mode, concurrency, leak checks, and privilege checks; hosted before/after digests in `user-data-baseline.txt` match and `leftover-check.txt` shows no test leftovers or sessions left switched on.
Inspected cited final screenshots for admin switch/QR, admin static view, participant success overlay, and switch-off participant screen; they match the required visible behavior.
regressions_checked: Switch-off sessions: API `{token}`/`{uid}` requests retain the old 400 body and write no `tag_events`, `sun_counters`, or team timestamps; `/t/{token}` sends no `/api/tag` request and writes no pending tag.
Mixed mode: final API/browser evidence covers SUN then static, static then SUN duplicate rejection, SUN replay rejection, and baseline-or-lower rejection in a switch-on session.
SUN routing: `/t/s?e&c` still credits via the existing SUN landing; admin SUN panel inspection remains available; `/t/s` without params shows the previous SUN-info-missing screens.

Security/leak surface: participant `/api/me`, `/api/tag`, `/api/join`, `/race` HTML, and participant `/t/{token}` HTML were checked for test tokens, UIDs, and key material; only the boolean switch is newly exposed.
Final regression ran after both Todo approvals, as shown by review and final-runtime file timestamps; no product code changes are recorded during FINAL validation.
